title: 叙事遗忘评估：LENS协议
summary: 提出LENS评估协议，用于测试大语言模型在直接、归因、对比和抽象四个层面上的目标叙事复现能力。引入抑制-崩溃效率（SCE）评分，平衡目标叙事抑制与输出质量。实验表明，选定检查点可减少叙事复现，且抑制可能迁移至直接遗忘提示之外。
summary_en: Introduces LENS, a contextualization-based evaluation protocol for testing target narrative reproduction across direct, attributed, contrastive, and abstract resistance levels. Proposes Suppression-Collapse Efficiency (SCE) score for checkpoint selection. Experiments show selected checkpoints reduce narrative reproduction and suppression may transfer beyond direct forget prompts.
